text:
Maya: deploy-bot just flagged 3 x ImagePullBackOff in canary for svc-frontend. Canary paused. Can someone take a look and advise rollback vs pin? @Noah @Rachel :eyes:

DeployBot: [automated] Canary health check failed for chart redwood/frontend-chart release svc-frontend-canary. 3 pods in CrashLoopBackOff/ImagePullBackOff. Paused at step 3. Suggested actions: investigate image digest availability, consider pinning to last-known-good image or rollback to release 202. Full bot log: https://ci.internal/redwood/deploy/2145678910

Noah: I pulled the node logs — looks like registry 503s in us-west-2 during the canary window. The image manifest might've been temporarily unavailable. I would prefer pinning the image digest in values and re-run the canary rather than immediate rollback. If pin fails after 10m, then rollback.

Noah: Quick pin example (will run from release engineer box):
```
helm upgrade svc-frontend redwood/frontend-chart --reuse-values \
  --set image.digest=sha256:1234abcd5678 --namespace prod --install
```

Rachel: +1 to pin first. Also please add an entry to release notes: "hotpatch: pin image digest due to transient registry manifest errors" and notify change-window and oncall. I'll open a small release-notes PR with the note and the original digest. ReleaseGenBot, can you attach the canary logs to the PR? :memo:

ReleaseGenBot: Attached canary logs to PR #4102. Generated draft note: "svc-frontend: temporary image pin to sha256:1234abcd5678 — observed ImagePullBackOff in canary (us-west-2). Monitoring ongoing."

Liao: If pin doesn't stabilize, prepare rollback cmd: 
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/svc-frontend --to-revision=5 -n prod
kubectl annotate deployment/svc-frontend rollout-pause=true -n prod
```
Also consider blocking new deploys by creating a release lock in the deploy bot: `deploy-bot lock svc-frontend --reason "canary imagepullbackoff"`

Maya: I'll run the helm pin now and monitor. I'll keep the canary paused until we confirm. If we don't see readiness within 10 minutes I'll escalate and run Liao's rollback steps. Notifying #prod-change-windows and paging oncall. :loud_sound:

Noah: Thanks — if the pin goes green please follow up with a short postmortem in #postmortems listing root cause as transient registry errors and the mitigation as image digest pin + improve registry retries.

Maya: ack — doing it now.
